inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Potential DNS Tunneling via Scripting Engines

properties.description: This detection identifies network connections to external DNS servers over TCP (port 53) initiated by common scripting engines like PowerShell, Python, or WScript. While DNS over TCP is a valid protocol, it is less common for standard queries and is often used by malware for command and control (C2) or data exfiltration through DNS tunneling.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Potential DNS Tunneling via Scripting Engines
